summary: iOS release 0.4.2 (Expo app, TestFlight): a new binary that carries the phone work merged since 0.4.1 build 6, including the expo-document-picker native module for file attachments. Settle, Snooze, the Details sheet, file attachments, approval reasons and the Share fix ship on; Hub children, phone live pages and the secret request card stay behind their flags.

desktop.reason: iOS version bump only; each feature's desktop part has its own manifest.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android ships on its own lane; this bump touches only apps/mobile.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API or wire change: the features in this binary already negotiate their backend capabilities.

automated: Expo jest and tsc pass; ios-testflight.yml verifies main CI and the source commit, builds the store IPA with the EAS store profile and remote build numbers, and submits that build to TestFlight.
notExercised: Installing the TestFlight build on a physical iPhone.
App Store review; 0.4.1 (build 6) is still in review and this release does not submit 0.4.2.
